rationale.runtime_parts: World BaseParts at runtime as perf_server.luau counts them (excl. slimes, characters, transients). Fixed cap, no ratchet: FAIL > fail, WARN (non-blocking) > warn. CI = offline fake-runtime count + WorldLayout.RUNTIME_SLOT_ALLOWANCE (tools/pr-gate/README.md calibration table).
rationale.world_triangles: CI only (tools/pr-gate/budget.sh: build mesh slots x shared/modeling-kit/out/<mesh>.fbx). Luau in Studio cannot compute triangles, so the Studio report keeps triangles = null (unknown, never a failure).
rationale.unique_meshes: Distinct MeshIds among the world MeshParts (perf_server unique_meshes). FAIL > fail.
rationale.mesh_parts: MeshPart count is SOFT: only warns above warn, never fails. The real mesh limits are world_triangles and unique_meshes.
